plain: Codex is OpenAI's agent for working on projects. It can read files, propose changes, write code and run tests. Describe the outcome you need, then review the changes before delivery. Use the app, editor extension or terminal.

account.free: Check availability and usage limits in your ChatGPT account. API billing is separate from a subscription.
steps: Choose the app, editor or terminal.
Use your account and review workspace permissions.
Open the correct folder and inspect its files.
Ask how to run the project and where its tests are.
account.warning: Keep a recoverable project version and review changes and test results before publishing.

first: Ask for a map of the folders and user journey.
Describe a bug with reproduction steps and an expected result.
Request a focused fix and a test that reproduces the bug.
Review changed files and run checks before delivery.
words: An assistant that can take steps using tools.
A comparison of old and new lines.
The reasoning engine; available options depend on your account.
matters: Define the observable behavior that must change.

ignore: Switching models before clearly describing the problem.
